scope: Post-hoc extension of original225 candidate /155 eligible species cohort; same temporal transitions and spatial folds as existing forecast

models.M5: Reuse previously saved host-composition predictions without refitting
models.B1_history: M5 features plus log distance to all preceding records at each origin, log counts of unique preceding record cells within50km and100km
models.B2_landmass: B1 plus log landmass area, unknown landmass flag, same-landmass prior-record flag, log nearest same-landmass prior-record distance capped20000km, log count same-landmass records within100km

history: 2001-2014 for2011-14 predictors;2001-2018 for2015-18 predictors. Historical cell counts are detection and effort dependent, not population sizes.
missing: Unassigned centres retained with explicit flag, log area0; same-landmass flag0 and distance20000 when unknown/no same-landmass prior record. Report classified-only sensitivity separately.
geography: GSHHG2.3.7 high-resolution level1 with sibling_id unifying dateline parts. Static proxy, no actual sea crossing or least-cost path claim.
settings: Reuse forecast_model_lock.json random_forest settings, species-equal weights, no tuning
scores: Species mean MSE and MAE; same evaluation rows; temporal and held spatial blocks; mainland/noncontinental and previously unrecorded subsets
ports: Excluded from first forecasting comparison: available inventory is2019, later than predictor origins.
DEM: Excluded from first comparison pending acquisition and historical-source review
interpretation: Incremental predictive value of recorded-distribution history and coarse landmass membership; not causal dispersal or transport
